changes: Reference stat/read/save exceptions cannot bypass the global closure observer because it runs in nested finally; fixed unavailable status requires STOP before verdict/native.

Reference stat size must be a nonnegative integer and at most16MiB; the stream reads at most16MiB+1. Absent, unavailable or oversized references cannot qualify. Exact hash-bound bounded bytes remain private in memory and are consumed by the verdict without an unbounded second read.

Global closure retains only fixed all-database/all-role/all-tag observation-completed/counts-valid/zero/absent booleans, even for malformed or throwing observers. Exact nonnegative int-zero counts are mandatory. No arbitrary observation or exception values are retained.
